About the Client -

Valuefy is a premier investment technology lab with cutting edge solutions serving the leading financial institutions in India and across the world.

About The Position

Designation - Backend Developer

Function - Financial Services

No. of Open Positions - 1

Engagement - Full Time

Payroll Entity - Client Payroll

Salary Range - Indian Rupees 6, 00, 000 to 10, 00, 000

Contact Name - Sharad Role and Responsibilities

We are looking for passionate back- end engineers love creating scalable applications with quality code. You should be able to build high- quality, innovative and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards and technical design.

About The Candidate

Essential Candidate Background - Organize full lifecycle software development

Prepare specifications and determine operational feasibility

Write well designed, testable, efficient code

Prepare software verification plans and quality assurance procedures

Organize documenting and maintenance of software functionality

Integrate software components into a fully functional software system

Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes and metrics

Desirable Candidate Background - 2+ years' experience of working as a Software Development Engineer.

Python - Should have sound knowledge of Django or Flask.Familiarity with event- driven programming in Python.

Understanding of the threading limitations of Python, and multi- process architecture.

Basic understanding of front- end technologies, such as JavaScript, HTML5.

Good understanding of Data Structure and Algorithm.

Sound knowledge of Database Designing.

Proficient understanding of code versioning tools (such as Git, Bitbucket).

BS degree in Computer Science or Engineering

Desired Education - BS (Computer Science or Engineering)

Experience Range - 2 to 5 years

Essential Keywords - Python, Django or Flask
